description: Na₃MnSiCO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.87 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent MnO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one SiO₄ tetrahedra,  a faceface with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one MnO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.76 Å. Mn is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted MnO₅ square pyramids that share corners with four equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.10 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent MnO₅ square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.29 Å) and one longer (1.32 Å) C-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one Si atom.
